# Two-layer cube (example ex3 of mfem-mgis-examples, whose sources are
# installed by mfem-mgis: isotropic linear elasticity, periodic boundary
# conditions, six loading cases), with its behaviour generated by the
# generic-parallel interface. The executable is the one of
# mfem-mgis-examples, run in its build directory, the behaviour library
# being given by its option -l; the mode of integration and the device are
# given by the environment variables of mfem-mgis (the example has no
# --device option).
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/../mfem-mgis-examples/ex3"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex3 of mfem-mgis-examples")

# tests of the six loading cases of the example on one process, the
# solution being compared to the analytical one by the example, point by
# point (generic library of the example), all the computations by kernels
# with the generic library and by batches with each backend. The tests of
# a case write the same ParaView files in the build directory of the
# example.
if(EXISTS "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR}/two_layer_cube")
  add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex3-behaviours CUDA
    "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR}/IsotropicLinearElasticity.mfront")
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  foreach(_case 0 1 2 3 4 5)
    set(_run ./two_layer_cube --test-case ${_case})
    set(_tests ex3-${_case}-point-par-point ex3-${_case}-noyaux)
    add_test(NAME ex3-${_case}-point-par-point COMMAND ${_run}
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR}")
    add_test(NAME ex3-${_case}-noyaux COMMAND ${_run}
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(ex3-${_case}-point-par-point PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
    set_tests_properties(ex3-${_case}-noyaux PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;${_kernels}")
    foreach(_backend ${ex3-behaviours_BACKENDS})
      set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
      set(_name ex3-${_case}-batch-${_backend})
      add_test(NAME ${_name} COMMAND ${_run} -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX3_DIR}")
      if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
        set_tests_properties(${_name} PROPERTIES
          ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_DEVICE=cuda;${_kernels}")
      else()
        set_tests_properties(${_name} PROPERTIES
          ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=2;${_kernels}")
      endif()
      list(APPEND _tests ${_name})
    endforeach()
    set_tests_properties(${_tests} PROPERTIES RESOURCE_LOCK ex3-${_case}-outputs)
    if(TEST ex3-${_case}-batch-cuda)
      set_tests_properties(ex3-${_case}-batch-cuda PROPERTIES
        RESOURCE_LOCK "gpu;ex3-${_case}-outputs")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
